LESSON: DEMOCRACY IN SCHOOL

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
Topic 5.4: Democracy in school

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

” to allow audio playback BENEFITS OF DEMOCRACY IN SCHOOL [Music] Hallo learner, welcome to a social studies lesson for grade 4. Today we shall learn about benefits of democracy in school. Your radio teacher is Eugene Kimani. Welcome to the programme. [Music]

SECTION 2: TEACHING CONTENT

” to allow audio playback BENEFITS OF DEMOCRACY IN SCHOOL [Music] Hallo learner, welcome to a social studies lesson for grade 4. Today we shall learn about benefits of democracy in school. Your radio teacher is Eugene Kimani. Welcome to the programme. [Music]

” to allow audio playback Hallo learner, welcome to our social studies lesson for grade 4 . Today we shall learn about benefits of democracy in school. So get your book and pencil and let us learn social studies. I am your radio teacher Eugene Kimani. [Music] I hope you have your book and pen ready and set to learn. We are going to start the lesson by remembering what we learnt about factors that promote peace in school. What did we say about factors that promote peace in school? [Music] Very good, we said the factors that promote peace in school include: love, respect, kindness, caring, hard work, peace, tolerance and obedience Today we are going to learn about benefits of democracy in school. Now what is democracy? Answer when you hear the music. [Music] Very good, democracy is a situation where we are allowed to take part in making decisions on issues that affect us. In which ways do you think we can practise democracy in school? Answer when you hear the music. [Music] Very good, we can practise democracy in the following ways: Choosing our leaders. Making class rules. Taking part in class discussions. Sharing duties. Taking part in debates. I will repeat, we can practise democracy in the following ways: Choosing our leaders. Making class rules. Taking part in class discussions. Sharing duties. Taking part in debates. Now, why do you think it is important to practice democracy in school? Answer when you hear the music. [Music] Very good, it is important to practice democracy in school because: Learners are able to say their ideas without fear. The school performs well when teachers are allowed to teach the subjects they are good at. Learners feel that they are part of the school when they take part in making decisions on issues affecting them. Learners are able to choose the leaders they feel have good leadership qualities. Learners who are chosen as leaders are prepared for future leadership roles.

” to allow audio playback Democracy encourages peace and harmony in school. When there is democracy in school, people treat each other fairly. Learner I will give you a small exercise. Say democracy or no democracy in these sentences I will read for you. Say democracy or no democracy, when I read each sentence. Do that when you hear the gong. Your parent allows you to say what you feel. Democracy or no democracy. [Bell] Your teacher allows you to answer questions. Democracy or no democracy. [Bell] Learners are not allowed to raise their hands in class. Democracy or no democracy. [Bell] Learner, I hope you were able to answer. Let us look at the sentences. Your parent allows you to say what you feel. Here, there is Democracy. Your teacher allows you to answer questions. Your teacher is practicing Democracy. Learners are not allowed to raise their hands in class. There is no Democracy here because learners are not allowed to be free and say what they think. This is your homework. How do you support student leaders in school? How do you support student leaders in school? Write down the answers and read them out to your parent or guardian. That is the end of our lesson for today. [Music] You have been listening to a social studies programme for grade 4 learners. Your radio teacher was Eugene Kimani. This programme was recorded by John Mbiti. It was produced by Zachary Kago for Educational Media Directorate, Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development. Until next time, Goodbye. [Music]

” to allow audio playback QUALITIES OF GOOD CITIZENSHIP IN SCHOOL Music Hallo learner, welcome to a social studies lesson grade 4 . Today we shall learn about qualities of good citizenship in school. Your radio teacher is Eugene Kimani. Welcome to the programme Music

” to allow audio playback Hallo learner, welcome to our social studies grade 4 lesson. Today we shall learn about qualities of good citizenship in school. So get your book and pencil and let us learn social studies. I am your radio teacher Eugene Kimani. Music I hope you have the book and pen ready and set to learn. We are going to start the lesson by remembering what we learnt about community leadership in our county. What does a community leader do in the county? Music I hope you were able to answer what a community leader does. Very good . A community leader: Teaches people about good values in the society. Examples of values are honesty, loyalty, kindness, truthfulness and so on. Community leader solves problems in the community. They guide people to know what is right and wrong. They lead people in prayers and worship. They make sure the culture and traditions of the community are not forgotten. They lead people in cultural events in the community. Now that we have said what a community leader does, Let’s get to today’s topic. We shall talk about qualities of good citizenship in school. Now who is a citizen? Music Very good, a citizen is a person who belongs to a particular place or country. Now let us look at what is citizenship? Citizenship is the act of belonging to a country and enjoying the rights that the citizens of that country enjoy. What can you do in school to make you a good learner? Answer when you hear the music Music Very good, we do things like: Help one another in doing various things. Keeping the school clean. Being at peace with others at all times. Sharing with one another. What are some the good qualities of learners in school? Answer when you hear the music. Music Very good, I hope you have said some of the qualities. I will now say some good qualities of learners in school. A good learner should be kind to others. A good learner should be honest. A good learner should be caring. A good learner should be obedient. A good learner should be responsible. A good learner should be hardworking. A good learner should be humble. A good learner should be tolerant. You can mention more if you have any.

” to allow audio playback I am now going to read out qualities of a learner. Write down if you hear any bad qualities of a learner. Are you ready? Here I go. Kind; disobedient; honest; lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. I repeat, write down if you hear any bad quality of a learner. Here I go. Kind; disobedient; honest; lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Did you write the bad qualities that you have heard? Music Very good, from our list, the following are the bad qualities of a bad learner. Disobedient, lazy, rude, irresponsible, a bully, greedy and selfish. Before doing something, we should always ask ourselves the following questions. Question 1 Will my teacher be happy with what I am going to do? Question 2 Will my parents be happy with what I am going to do? Question 3 Will what I am going to do help other learners in school? Question 4 Will what I am going to do help me do well in school? When we practice good citizenship in school, there is good performance. Things in school are taken well care of and there is peace and harmony. I am now going to read out good qualities of a learner. Write down if you hear any qualities of a good learner. Are you ready? Here I go. Kind, disobedient, honest, lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Did you write the good qualities that you have heard? Let me read them again. Kind, disobedient, honest, lazy, generous, caring, rude, irresponsible, peaceful, a bully, tolerant, greedy, hardworking, humble and selfish. Music I hope you have written the following words: Kind, honest, caring, tolerant, hardworking and humble. Learner, show how you can be a good child at home. With that, we have now come to the end of the lesson for today.

” to allow audio playback THE SCHOOL [ Music] Hello Learner, welcome to social studies for grade 4. Today we are going to learn about the school. Your radio teacher is Esther Simaloi. Welcome to the program. [Music]

” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner. Welcome to our social studies lesson. Today we are going to learn about the school. We shall learn what the school motto and core values are and tell our school daily routine. First let us remind ourselves what we learnt in the previous lesson. In the previous lesson we learnt about culture. What is culture? # Bell # Good Culture is the way of life of people in a community. How do you show your culture? # Bell # I hope your answers include; The food we eat. The way we dress. The houses we live in Through festivals and ceremonies performed in the community. We also learnt the importance of culture. Do you remember? State some of them. # Bell # Good. I hope your answers include; It identifies who we are. It is a tourist attraction. and We learn a lot about other people's culture. It helps us to live in peace with each other and respect each other. What is a school? # Bell # Do you go to school? # Bell # Are you in school today? # Bell # A school is an educational institution designed to provide learning environments for the teaching of Learners under the direction and supervision of teachers. What is the name of your school? # Bell # In which county is your school? # Bell # Does your school have a school motto? # Bell # A school motto is a short statement that shows the aims of a school. Examples of school motto are; 1. tudy for service, study for service. 2. Diligence rewards, diligence rewards. 3. Strive for excellence, strive for excellence 4. Cooperate for succes, cooperate for succes, A school motto helps in motivating us to achieve our goals What is your school motto? What is your school motto? # Bell #

” to allow audio playback Core values on the other hand are guiding beliefs which help us to do the right things in the school. Examples of values that help us to do the right things in school are; 1) Responsibility. 2) Respect. 3) Excellence. 4) Care and compassion. 5) Understanding. 6) Trustworthiness. 7) Honesty. 8) Tolerance. 9) Being ethical What are the core values in your school? # Bell # Let us discuss some of the values we have just mentioned above Honesty. What is honesty? # Bell # Honesty means telling the truth all the time. When you are honest you will avoid telling lies. Learner, are you honest? Are you honest? # Bell # Another value is responsibility. In school we show responsibility by doing school work, c leaning the classrooms. cleaning the school compound and other duties given to us without being reminded. How do we show responsibility at home? # Bell # At home we show responsibility by doing our homework, taking care of animals washing our clothes and sweeping the house among other duties. Another value is respect. Learner , how do we show respect? # Bell # We show respect by; being polite when you talk to your elders parents teachers and friends. standing attention when raising the national flag. How else do we show respect? # Bell # We should respect our parents, elders, teachers and friends. What are the core values of your school? What are the core values of your school? # Bell # What do you do to practice the motto and core values of your school? What do you do to practice the mortal and core values of your school? # Bell # Lastly a school daily routine is a program of activities done in the school on every school day. It ensures that each activity is given enough time and all the day's activities in the school are ran smoothly. What is your first activity in your school on Monday? What is your first activity in your school on Monday? # Bell #

” to allow audio playback What time do the activities begin? What time do the activities begin? # Bell # How long does the activity take? How long does the activity take? # Bell # School routines enable has to learn smoothly and well. We also become disciplined by following the school routine. To conclude the lesson, share your school routine with your parents or guardians. Let them share with you their school routine too when they were in school. That brings us to the end of our lesson today until next time. Goodbye. Music That was social studies lesson for grade 4, the radio presenter was teacher Esther Simaloi The program was written by a social studies media panel. It was produced by the Media and Extension Services and recorded by Johnson Mwangi for the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development. Until next time. It's goodbye. Music

1. Re-read the teaching content and underline three new words or ideas.
2. Explain the main idea of this topic to a parent or classmate in your own words.
3. Write five sentences using examples from your school or county.
4. Complete the revision quiz for this topic. Check answers only after finishing.
